headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 27, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a crucial 8-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with AJ Blubaugh earning the win after pitching 2.0 innings with 2 strikeouts and no earned runs. Kerry Carpenter led the Astros' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Blake Dunn, the Cincinnati Reds' center fielder, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain. Other notable injuries include Hoby Milner (appendicitis), Jesús Sánchez (right ankle sprain), Daniel Susac (low back strain), Phil Maton (right knee tendinitis), Marcelo Mayer (bone stress reaction to the left ulna), Robert Suarez (right forearm tightness), and Wenceel Pérez (left orbital fracture).

The Toronto Blue Jays made a trade on June 27, acquiring catcher Owen Carapellotti from the Athletics. Other notable trades include the Chicago Cubs acquiring left-hander David Peterson from the New York Mets for third baseman Cole Mathis, and the Houston Astros acquiring shortstop Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Red Sox in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox defeated the New York Yankees 4-1, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Masataka Yoshida led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Blue Jays 7-4**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 7-4 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Peyton Gray earning the win. Yohendrick Piñango led the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 9-7**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-7 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs.
